content.text: Here's my plan for wiring up the new authentication middleware: I'll start by auditing the existing session token handling in the auth package, then refactor the token validation logic into a dedicated validator module so it can be unit tested in isolation. Next I'll update the login and refresh handlers to call the new validator, add structured logging around token expiry and rotation events, and write integration tests that cover the happy path plus three failure modes: expired token, malformed token, and revoked token. Once the tests are green I'll update the API docs and open a PR for review. Let me know if you want me to also cover the password-reset flow in this same pass, or keep it scoped to session tokens only.
